answer: The anchor graph is rebuilt each epoch, thus the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the nectar audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 4 times its size, so a group of 19 keys loses far more than 19 single identities would. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the thread checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
